answer.rationale: Renewal is the only direction supported by demonstrated delivery continuity under a 14-day deadline and 94% committed-volume utilization with no buffer. Switching could support the cost mandate, but memory_c2 establishes cost, onboarding, and invoicing benefits—not delivery performance under constrained conditions—so that record should be verified before treating a switch as risk-neutral. Renewal protects production now, while the 18% savings gap remains unresolved for the next review.
